Apple Inc. History: Apple Inc. was founded on April 1, 1976, by Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak, and Ronald Wayne in Cupertino, California.

Avatar Film Overview: Avatar (2009) was written and directed by James Cameron, a Canadian filmmaker born in Kapuskasing, Ontario, Canada.

Mexico City Topography: Mexico City lies in the Valley of Mexico at an elevation of 2,240 meters (7,350 feet) above sea level, surrounded by mountains.

Niels Bohr Physics Career: Niels Bohr was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1922 for his services in the investigation of the structure of atoms and of the radiation emanating from them.

Indian Ocean Geographical Profile: The Indian Ocean covers an area of approximately 70.56 million square kilometers (27.24 million square miles), ranking third among world oceans.

Nitrogen Periodic Table Data: Nitrogen is a chemical element with symbol N and atomic number 7, constituting about 78% of Earth's atmosphere.
